extracted.name: Roti Boy (coffee bun with butter & cheese filling)
extracted.description: The taste of coffee is always my fave🥰 makes me happy to eat it
ingredient_lines: 60 ml veg oil, canola, or any cooking oil
1 tsp cake emulsifier or 1 egg yolk or skip
1/2 cup water, then boil with lower temperature
1 tbs coffee mix with 150 ml of water
instruction_lines: Prepare the wateroof and let it cool
Mix all ingredient and please wait the yeast 5 minutes to be active
Mixer all flour and wateroof with low speed in 10 minutes. Wait 2 hours to make sure the dough become double size. Cover with clean cloth.
After 2 hours, divided the dough into 8 pieces or 60 gram each
Fill each of them with butter and cheddar cheese
Leave them approximately 10 minutes, before you put topping
Place topping mix on top of them, and bake with 350 F around 15-17 minutes.
